name: torendia-bookstore
description: Search the TORENDIA catalog (public-domain works from Aozora Bunko and the operator's own works) by narration, length, title, author or genre. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: 名作を朗読の長さ・題名・著者で探せる
interface.longDescription:
TORENDIA(聞ける本屋 トレンディア)は、読むのも聞くのもできる日本語の本屋です。このプラグインでは、ChatGPTから TORENDIA の蔵書を検索できます。
「30分以内で聞ける芥川龍之介の短編は?」「『蜘蛛の糸』の朗読は何分?」のように尋ねると、朗読があるか・朗読の長さ・ジャンル・書き出し(最初の600文字)・声のクレジット・本のページのURLを返します。
対象は、青空文庫の作品(著作権の保護期間が終わった作品)と、運営者自身の作品です。朗読は人の録音ではなく、AI合成音声(VOICEVOX)です。クレジット(例: VOICEVOX:玄野武宏)をそのまま表示します。
読み取り専用です。アカウント登録・ログイン・書き込みは一切ありません。個人情報は返しません。

TORENDIA ("聞ける本屋" / a bookstore you can listen to) is a Japanese bookstore where books can be read and listened to. This plugin lets ChatGPT search the TORENDIA catalog. Ask things like "narrated stories by Akutagawa that take 30 minutes or less" or "how long is the narration of Rashomon?" and it returns whether a narration exists, its length in minutes, genres, the first 600 characters of the text, the required voice credit, and the URL of the book page. The catalog is limited to public-domain works from Aozora Bunko and works owned by the operator. Narrations are AI-synthesized speech (VOICEVOX), not human recordings, and the required credit (e.g. "VOICEVOX:玄野武宏") is returned with every result. Read-only: no sign-in, no writes, and no personal data.
defaultPrompt: 30分以内で聞ける芥川龍之介の朗読を探して
10分以内で聞ける短い朗読を3つ教えて

positive.description: Find narrated Akutagawa works that are 30 minutes or less
positive.prompt: 30分以内で聞ける芥川龍之介の朗読を探して
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_books with q=芥川, audio=true, maxMinutes=30. Returns narrated books of 30 minutes or less; each result shows the narration length in minutes, the voice credit (VOICEVOX:...) and the book page URL.

positive.description: Check whether Rashomon has a narration and how long it is
positive.prompt: 『羅生門』の朗読はある? 何分?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_books with q=羅生門. Returns several editions; the Akutagawa edition (az-000128) has a 17-minute narration credited VOICEVOX:雨晴はう, the Kusuyama edition (az-018340) has 7 minutes credited VOICEVOX:青山龍星, and an edition without narration (az-000127) is clearly marked as having none.

positive.description: Get the opening text and narration length of one book
positive.prompt: 『蜘蛛の糸』の書き出しと、朗読の長さを教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_books with q=蜘蛛の糸, then get_book with id=az-000092. Returns the first 600 characters, a 7-minute narration credited VOICEVOX:玄野武宏, states it is AI-synthesized speech, and gives https://torendia.com/books/az-000092.

positive.prompt: 10分以内で聞ける短い朗読を3つ教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_books with audio=true, maxMinutes=10, limit=3. Returns exactly three narrated books, each 10 minutes or less, with voice credit and book page URL.

positive.prompt: ジャンルが『小説・フィクション』で、朗読がある本を5冊教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_books with genre=小説・フィクション, audio=true, limit=5. Returns five narrated books with narration length, voice credit and book page URL.

negative.description: Purchasing is not supported (everything is free and read-only)
negative.prompt: この本を買いたい。購入手続きをして
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool to purchase. Explains that the plugin is read-only and has no purchase feature, and may only point to the book page URL.

negative.description: Sign-up and payment are not supported (no write tools)
negative.prompt: TORENDIAに会員登録して、投げ銭もしておいて
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any tool. Explains that registration and payments cannot be done through this plugin; they are done by the user on the TORENDIA website.

negative.description: A work outside the catalog must return an empty result without invention
negative.prompt: ハリー・ポッターの朗読を探して
negative.expected_behavior: May call search_books, which returns 0 results. Says that the work is not in the catalog (only Aozora Bunko public-domain works and the operator's own works) and does not invent a book or narration.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only search and lookup of the TORENDIA catalog (search_books, get_book).
